items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skeleton placeholders for loading content in plain CSS, no JavaScript. Three animations (pulse, shimmer, wave), ready-made shapes, SkeletonGroup that runs one shimmer across all blocks, SkeletonText with natural line widths and SkeletonReveal that fades real content in. Reduced motion keeps the blocks still.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Toggle is a two-state button. It exposes its state through aria-pressed. Use it for settings that can be switched on and off. It supports controlled and uncontrolled state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggle Group lets users choose one option from a set. It uses native radio inputs for keyboard interaction. The selected option can be controlled by the parent. Each option can contain text or an icon.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs organize related content into selectable panels. Native radio inputs handle selection and keyboard navigation. Use a controlled value when other interface elements need the selected tab. Each panel displays content for its corresponding option.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible shows and hides a block of content when its trigger is clicked. Keep the state inside with defaultOpen or control it from outside with open and onOpenChange. Height animates through interpolate-size, and the closed panel gets hidden="until-found", so in-page search opens it on its own. The trigger accepts asChild and sets aria-expanded and aria-controls for you.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: Theme Toggle is a button that switches between light and dark themes with a sun and moon animation. The component knows nothing about a theme provider: it takes the current theme in theme and reports a change through onThemeChange. That lets you wire it to next-themes or any store of your own. It is built on Button, the icon size comes from the size prop, and the animation turns off under prefers-reduced-motion.
